integrity: Proof included; independent validation and historical priority certification have not been performed; Kruse–Polydorides–Wu (2019 preprint) retains priority for randomized stiffness assembly.
scientific_limitations: Only one-dimensional positive finitely piecewise-constant conductivity, zero source, one-point independently sampled standard P1 stiffness; the full mesh-phase law requires rationally independent interface locations. This is a physical-flux theorem, not an all-norm or multidimensional convergence assertion.
title: Exact arithmetic-phase flux laws for random-point finite-element interface assembly
